## Input Files

```{r}
resolve_existing_path <- function(candidates) {
  existing <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(existing) == 0) {
    stop(
      "Could not find the LOD input directory. Checked:\n",
      paste(candidates, collapse = "\n")
    )
  }
  existing[[1]]
}

lod_input_dir <- resolve_existing_path(c(
  "../Input/Harmonized_Datasets",
  "../../Input/Harmonized_Datasets",
  "../../../Input/Harmonized_Datasets",
  "Input/Harmonized_Datasets"
))

lod_summary_file <- file.path(lod_input_dir, "Harmonized_Targeted_LOD_Summary.csv")
lod_crossstudy_file <- file.path(lod_input_dir, "Harmonized_Targeted_LOD_CrossStudy_Summary.csv")
lod_flagged_file <- file.path(lod_input_dir, "Harmonized_Targeted_LOD_CrossStudy_Flagged.csv")
lod_study_analyte_file <- file.path(lod_input_dir, "Harmonized_Targeted_Study_Analyte_LOD.csv")

lod_summary <- readr::read_csv(lod_summary_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
lod_crossstudy <- readr::read_csv(lod_crossstudy_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
lod_flagged <- readr::read_csv(lod_flagged_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
lod_study_analyte <- readr::read_csv(lod_study_analyte_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

load("../../../Input/Harmonized_Datasets/Harmonized_Targeted.RData")
```

## Quick Overview

```{r}
overview_tbl <- tibble(
  Dataset = c(
    "LOD summary by study-analyte",
    "Cross-study LOD summary",
    "Flagged cross-study analytes",
    "Study-analyte within-study LOD summary"
  ),
  Rows = c(
    nrow(lod_summary),
    nrow(lod_crossstudy),
    nrow(lod_flagged),
    nrow(lod_study_analyte)
  ),
  Columns = c(
    ncol(lod_summary),
    ncol(lod_crossstudy),
    ncol(lod_flagged),
    ncol(lod_study_analyte)
  )
)

kable(overview_tbl)
```

```{r}
high_level_metrics <- tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Unique studies in LOD summary",
    "Unique analytes in LOD summary",
    "Unique analytes in cross-study summary",
    "Flagged analytes",
    "Analytes with within-study LOD variation",
    "Study-analyte rows with more than one unique LOD"
  ),
  Value = c(
    dplyr::n_distinct(lod_summary$Study),
    dplyr::n_distinct(lod_summary$Analyte_Code),
    dplyr::n_distinct(lod_crossstudy$Analyte_Code),
    nrow(lod_flagged),
    sum(lod_crossstudy$Any_Within_Study_LOD_Variation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(lod_study_analyte$N_Unique_LOD_Within_Study > 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

kable(high_level_metrics)
```

## Summary Tables

```{r}
study_summary_tbl <- lod_summary %>%
  group_by(Study) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Analytes = n(),
    Median_Pct_Below_LOD = median(Pct_Results_Below_LOD, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Pct_Below_LOD = mean(Pct_Results_Below_LOD, na.rm = TRUE),
    N_All_Below_LOD = sum(Pct_Results_Below_LOD == 100, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Median_Pct_Below_LOD), desc(N_All_Below_LOD)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Median_Pct_Below_LOD))

kable(study_summary_tbl, digits = 2)
```

```{r}
top_crossstudy_tbl <- lod_crossstudy %>%
  arrange(desc(LOD_Fold_Difference), desc(N_Studies)) %>%
  select(
    Chemical_Group,
    Analyte_Code,
    Units,
    N_Studies,
    Min_Study_LOD,
    Median_Study_LOD,
    Max_Study_LOD,
    LOD_Fold_Difference,
    Any_Within_Study_LOD_Variation
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

kable(top_crossstudy_tbl, digits = 3)
```

## Plot 1: Percent of Results Below LOD Across Studies

```{r}
p_pct_below_hist <- lod_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Pct_Results_Below_LOD)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "#2C7FB8", color = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Percent of Results Below the LOD",
    x = "Percent of results below LOD",
    y = "Study-analyte combinations"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p_pct_below_hist
```

## Plot 2: Median Percent Below LOD by Study

```{r}
p_study_median <- study_summary_tbl %>%
  arrange(Median_Pct_Below_LOD) %>%
  mutate(Study = factor(Study, levels = unique(Study))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Study, y = Median_Pct_Below_LOD)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#1B9E77") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Percent Below LOD by Study",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Median percent of results below LOD"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p_study_median
```

## Plot 3: Largest Cross-Study LOD Differences

```{r}
top_crossstudy_plot_df <- lod_crossstudy %>%
  mutate(
    Analyte_Label = paste(Chemical_Group, Analyte_Code, sep = " :: ")
  ) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = LOD_Fold_Difference, n = 25, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(LOD_Fold_Difference) %>%
  mutate(Analyte_Label = factor(Analyte_Label, levels = unique(Analyte_Label)))

p_crossstudy_diff <- top_crossstudy_plot_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Analyte_Label, y = LOD_Fold_Difference, fill = N_Studies)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#9ECAE1", high = "#08519C") +
  labs(
    title = "Top Analytes by Cross-Study LOD Fold Difference",
    x = NULL,
    y = "LOD fold difference (log scale)",
    fill = "N studies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p_crossstudy_diff
```

## Plot 4: Cross-Study LOD Range Versus Number of Studies

```{r}
p_crossstudy_scatter <- lod_crossstudy %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = N_Studies,
    y = LOD_Fold_Difference,
    color = Any_Within_Study_LOD_Variation
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2.8) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F0E", `FALSE` = "#238B45")) +
  labs(
    title = "Cross-Study LOD Spread by Number of Studies",
    x = "Number of studies contributing to analyte",
    y = "LOD fold difference (log scale)",
    color = "Within-study\nvariation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p_crossstudy_scatter
```

## Plot 5: Within-Study LOD Variation by Study

```{r}
within_study_summary <- lod_study_analyte %>%
  group_by(Study) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Analytes = n(),
    N_With_Within_Study_Variation = sum(N_Unique_LOD_Within_Study > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pct_With_Within_Study_Variation = 100 * N_With_Within_Study_Variation / N_Analytes,
    Median_Unique_LOD = median(N_Unique_LOD_Within_Study, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Pct_With_Within_Study_Variation), desc(Median_Unique_LOD))

kable(within_study_summary, digits = 2)
```

```{r}
p_within_study <- within_study_summary %>%
  arrange(Pct_With_Within_Study_Variation) %>%
  mutate(Study = factor(Study, levels = unique(Study))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Study, y = Pct_With_Within_Study_Variation, fill = Median_Unique_LOD)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FEE8C8", high = "#E34A33") +
  labs(
    title = "Within-Study LOD Variation by Study",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percent of analytes with >1 unique LOD",
    fill = "Median\nunique LODs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p_within_study
```

## Plot 6: Heatmap for Flagged Analytes

```{r}
flagged_analytes <- lod_flagged %>%
  arrange(desc(LOD_Fold_Difference)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  select(Chemical_Group, Analyte_Code)

flagged_heatmap_df <- lod_study_analyte %>%
  semi_join(flagged_analytes, by = c("Chemical_Group", "Analyte_Code")) %>%
  mutate(
    Analyte_Label = paste(Chemical_Group, Analyte_Code, sep = " :: "),
    Study = std_study(Study)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Analyte_Label) %>%
  mutate(Study_LOD_Median_Scaled = Study_LOD_Median / min(Study_LOD_Median, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

flagged_heatmap_levels <- flagged_heatmap_df %>%
  group_by(Analyte_Label) %>%
  summarise(Max_Scaled_LOD = max(Study_LOD_Median_Scaled, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Max_Scaled_LOD) %>%
  pull(Analyte_Label)

p_flagged_heatmap <- flagged_heatmap_df %>%
  mutate(Analyte_Label = factor(Analyte_Label, levels = flagged_heatmap_levels)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = Study,
    y = Analyte_Label,
    fill = Study_LOD_Median_Scaled
  )) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    trans = "log10",
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Relative Median LOD Across Studies for Flagged Analytes",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Median LOD /\nminimum study LOD"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

p_flagged_heatmap
```
